description.mekanicalcreate.simulation_c: Centralizes Create processing in a Mekanism-style factory.
description.mekanicalcreate.fluid_mekani: Controller for an expandable 3×3×3 to 7×7×7 item-and-fluid processing multiblock.
description.mekanicalcreate.mekanical_fa: Forms the frame and walls of a Mekanical Factory multiblock.
Use a Configurator to select yellow catalyst, red input, blue output, or green energy routing.
Install inside the factory; each core adds 25% processing speed. Only the first 4 take effect.
Install inside the factory; each core adds 100 kFE of storage. Only the first 4 take effect.
Install inside the factory to unlock tanks and increase capacity. Only the first 2 take effect.
Install inside the factory; each core unlocks 2 universal catalyst slots. Only the first 3 take effect, for 8 slots total.
jei.mekanicalcreate.info: Centralizes supported Create processing recipes with configurable modules and Mekanism-style automation; accepts Mekanism factory installers for tier upgrades.
jei.mekanicalcreate.fluid_info: Expandable 3×3×3 to 7×7×7 multiblock: every edge and corner must use Factory Casings; flat faces may freely mix Factory Casings and Mekanism Structural Glass. Place one Controller and at least one Port on the shell. Speed, Energy, Fluid, and Catalyst Cores go inside; use a Configurator to select yellow catalyst, red input, blue output, or green energy ports.

multiblock.mekanicalcreate.invalid.no_po: The Mekanical Factory needs at least one universal port.

mekanicalcreate.ponder.mekanical_factory: Every whole size from 3×3×3 through 7×7×7 is supported
This 5×5×5 shell is a clear mid-sized example
Place exactly one Controller and at least one Port on a flat face
Ports switch between red input, yellow catalyst, blue output, and green energy
Only the first 4 Speed Cores take effect
Only the first 4 Energy Cores take effect
Only the first 2 Fluid Cores take effect
Each of the first 3 Catalyst Cores unlocks 2 more slots
